note: Search keywords for the Group risk universe, kept apart from the verbatim transcription in STE-Risk-Universe.json. REGISTER_NAME entries are the register's own risk name with any bracketed text removed, and only when it is five words or fewer, since a longer sentence will not appear verbatim in news. PROPOSED entries were drafted for review and must not be matched until a human sets them to APPROVED.
keywordRule: 6 or more characters, or more than one word. Shorter single words cause false hits.

excluded.reason: The source shifted N1.1 to CC1.1 and left it without a description.
